content: .{@-अंशः@} .²1 a sixth part in general. .²2 particularly, the sixth part of the produce of fields <ab>&c.</ab>, which the king takes from his subjects as land-tax; ऊधस्यमिच्छामि तवोपभोक्तुं षष्ठांशमुर्व्या इव रक्षितायाः <ls>R. 2. 66</ls>; (the different kinds of produce, to the sixth part of which a king is entitled, are specified in <ls>Ms. 7. 131-132)</ls>.
